notes.title: Postponing the release of CG: Girls 3 to 2026.
notes.notes:
In the two months since the announcement of [b]CG: Girls 3[/b], the number of people who added the game to their Wishlist is twice less than the number of people who added [b]CG: Girls 2[/b] during the same period. Based on this data, it was decided to postpone the release of the game to[b] Q1 2026[/b] (tentatively the end of January).

In the meantime, you can add a new game to your Wishlist - [b]Coloring Game 10K[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3759780/Coloring_Game_10K/


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3525390/Coloring_Game_Girls_3/

notes.title: Without using AI
notes.notes:
Lately it is very fashionable among some people to see AI everywhere. Especially people who have nothing to do with the field they are talking about like to do it. 
In our case, ordinary people (not artists) write that we have pictures created by AI.
What is pixelart created by AI (at the moment) they do not understand.

For these people, we have specially saved the stages of creating a picture for the game.
